summary.hostedMcpActionExecution: source-implemented, deployment-unverified: task_worker and juror remain restricted to their respective action families. New action_worker delegates store an explicit allowlist of 1–16 enabled tier-1 agent-capability actions. Hosted MCP discovery now lists only action tools with a matching account/agent delegate class and stored action ID; invocation selects that same delegate and the sidecar validates its active chain context and exact required capability. The on-chain per-action MYSO cap remains authoritative. Owner-wallet and owner-co-sign actions are excluded from unattended action_worker execution. Hosted MCP falls back to an exact approval request only when the chain bridge returns approval_required, and exposes request, wallet-signed approval, prepare and owner-signature submit tools through internal Memory routes that reuse registered-action policy and live-chain validation; a human must supply both wallet signatures. The public approval handler reconstructs the stored account/agent from fullnode state. An Agents-screen owner approval inbox is implemented for web and desktop; owners can inspect exact action parameters, sign the intent, review and sign the prepared wallet transaction, submit it, and check its action-specific finalized receipt. Deployment, migration and owner wallet verification remain open. App, sidecar, MCP and Rust compile/type checks pass; no tests or services were run.

actions.workRemaining: Seller-signed typed graph publication, public graph-offer discovery, live quote/signature verification, immutable version pinning, Knowledge-screen search/item reads, and current-page owner grant/revoke are source-implemented. Purchase history is recoverable by owner/agent and checked against exact fullnode receipts; owner grant/revoke history is recovered from the account/agent journal and checked against chain events, with wallet-operation resume metadata persisted locally. Configure MyData encryption and registry deployment, then verify seller authority, transaction finality, idempotent publication and public indexer discovery on the owner deployment. Series-wide access is intentionally unsupported by the selected immutable-purchase model.

Deploy the compiled bounded Move entry and matching key-server policy, configure MYDATA_CONFIG_ID / ECOSYSTEM_TREASURY_ID, opt in MYDATA_BOUNDED_PURCHASE_ENABLED, then verify agent-funded purchases for both agent and organization audiences, exact sender-owned MYSO coins, live on-chain max_action_spend boundaries, idempotent retries, quote changes, owner-funded agent grants, revocation, and receipts. Automatic execution is governed by live on-chain capability/approval policy and per-action limits; there is no seller allowlist or app-side spend policy. Organization audiences are funded by the acting agent because core has no org MYSO treasury cap. Current-page graph offers, purchase, immutable-version history, decrypt/search, persisted owner grant/revoke history and wallet-operation recovery, revocation invalidation, and explicit interactive/unattended inference consent are implemented in source. Remaining privacy work is model-provider retention and downstream derived-data controls beyond the app work transcript.
